overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board had released the Purpose 3 FAA-litigation minutes with redactions, so they were no longer withheld under the OML. Privilege redactions were referred to the Supervisor of Records.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board failed to timely release executive session minutes about FAA litigation (4L RNAV), which were released with redactions.
allegations.key_passage: Because the relevant portions of the executive session minutes are no longer being withheld from the public under the Open Meeting Law, we find no violation of that law.

allegations.summary: Whether the attorney-client and work-product privilege redactions to the released executive session minutes were justified.
allegations.key_passage: Any dispute regarding a public body’s claim that minutes are exempt from disclosure pursuant to the attorney-client privilege or an exemption to the Public Records Law should be directed to the Supervisor of Records
